title: 🔥 THE MOST IGNORED COMMAND OF JESUS: ‘REPENT OR PERISH!’ 🔥
paragraphs:
🔥 THE MOST IGNORED COMMAND OF JESUS: ‘REPENT OR PERISH!’ 🔥
📖 Luke 13:3 – "Unless you repent, you too will all perish."
Many people claim to follow Jesus, yet they ignore His most urgent warning—REPENTANCE.

🚨 The modern church loves to preach about God’s love, blessings, and grace.
❌ But where is the call to holiness?
❌ Where is the message of turning away from sin?
❌ Where is the warning of judgment for those who refuse to repent?

Jesus didn’t say, "Live however you want, and I’ll still accept you."
🔥 He said, "Repent, or you will perish!"
This is the most ignored command in today’s churches. Let’s uncover the truth about repentance and why your eternity depends on it!

🔥 1. WHAT DOES IT MEAN TO REPENT?
📖 Acts 3:19 – "Repent, then, and turn to God, so that your sins may be wiped out, that times of refreshing may come from the Lord."

The Greek word for "repent" is "metanoia" (μετάνοια), which means:
✔️ A complete change of mind
✔️ A turning away from sin
✔️ A radical transformation of heart

🚨 Repentance is NOT just feeling sorry!
❌ Repentance is not just crying after you sin and going back to it.
❌ Repentance is not just saying "Sorry, Lord" but never changing.
❌ Repentance is not just confessing sins while still living in rebellion.

🔥 TRUE REPENTANCE MEANS:
✔️ Turning away from sin and running to Jesus!
✔️ Surrendering your will to obey God’s commands!
✔️ Living differently because you are transformed!

💡 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
A thief who steals, confesses, but keeps stealing has NOT repented.
A thief who steals, is convicted, and stops stealing—THAT is repentance!
👉 Are you just sorry for your sin, or have you truly repented?

🔥 2. WHY IS REPENTANCE NECESSARY FOR SALVATION?
📖 Acts 17:30 – "In the past, God overlooked such ignorance, but now He commands all people everywhere to repent."
🔥 Without repentance, there is no forgiveness!

✔️ Jesus’ first message was REPENTANCE! (Matthew 4:17)
✔️ John the Baptist prepared the way with REPENTANCE! (Matthew 3:2)
✔️ The apostles preached REPENTANCE! (Acts 2:38)

❌ But today, churches preach "Just accept Jesus into your heart" WITHOUT repentance.
❌ Many people think they can believe in Jesus but continue living in sin.
❌ Many assume that because God is loving, He won’t send them to hell.

🚨 THE TRUTH: THERE IS NO SALVATION WITHOUT REPENTANCE!
✔️ Faith without repentance is false salvation.
✔️ Believing in Jesus without repentance is self-deception.
✔️ Saying "I love God" while living in sin is hypocrisy.

💡 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
You CANNOT follow Jesus and still walk in the world.
👉 If you’re still living like the world, have you truly repented?

🔥 3. REPENTANCE VS. RELIGION – DON’T BE FOOLED!
📖 Matthew 7:21 – "Not everyone who says to Me, ‘Lord, Lord,’ will enter the kingdom of heaven, but only the one who does the will of My Father."
🚨 Many think they are saved, but they are just religious!

❌ Religion says: "Go to church, give tithes, and you’re saved!"
🔥 Jesus says: "Repent and follow Me!" (Luke 9:23)

❌ Religion says: "God understands if you keep sinning."
🔥 Jesus says: "Go and sin no more!" (John 8:11)

❌ Religion says: "Just say the sinner’s prayer, and you’re saved forever."
🔥 Jesus says: "If you do not repent, you will perish!" (Luke 13:5)

💡 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
Going to church does not make you saved—REPENTANCE does.
👉 Are you just religious, or have you truly turned away from sin?

🔥 4. WHAT HAPPENS IF YOU DON’T REPENT?
📖 Hebrews 10:26 – "If we deliberately keep on sinning after receiving the knowledge of the truth, no sacrifice for sins is left."
🚨 Refusing to repent has eternal consequences!

❌ SIN SEPARATES YOU FROM GOD. (Isaiah 59:2)
❌ SIN ENSLAVES YOU TO THE DEVIL. (John 8:34)
❌ SIN LEADS TO ETERNAL DEATH. (Romans 6:23)
🔥 If you die in your sin without repentance, you will face the WRATH of God!

💡 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
If a person knows they have cancer but refuses treatment, they WILL die.
👉 If you know sin leads to hell, why are you refusing to repent?
🚨 HELL IS FULL OF PEOPLE WHO WAITED TOO LONG TO REPENT!

🔥 5. HOW TO TRULY REPENT AND BE SAVED!
📖 2 Corinthians 7:10 – "Godly sorrow brings repentance that leads to salvation and leaves no regret, but worldly sorrow brings death."
🔥 TRUE REPENTANCE REQUIRES ACTION!

✔️ 1. CONFESS YOUR SINS TO GOD! (1 John 1:9)
✔️ 2. TURN AWAY FROM YOUR OLD LIFE! (Ephesians 4:22-24)
✔️ 3. HATE SIN AND LOVE HOLINESS! (Psalm 97:10)
✔️ 4. FOLLOW JESUS DAILY! (Luke 9:23)
✔️ 5. ASK THE HOLY SPIRIT FOR STRENGTH! (Galatians 5:16)

💡 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
A person who truly repents doesn’t go back to sin—they fight against it daily!
👉 Are you still tolerating sin, or are you fighting for holiness?

🔥 FINAL WARNING: REPENT TODAY—TOMORROW IS NOT GUARANTEED!
📖 Proverbs 27:1 – "Do not boast about tomorrow, for you do not know what a day may bring."

🚨 You are NOT promised another day!
❌ Many thought they had time to repent—then they died suddenly.
❌ Many planned to change later—then they faced judgment.
🔥 JESUS IS CALLING YOU TO REPENT TODAY!
👉 WILL YOU OBEY, OR WILL YOU IGNORE HIS WARNING?

🙏 POWERFUL PRAYER FOR TRUE REPENTANCE
"Lord Jesus, I repent of my sins and turn away from my old life. Forgive me for my rebellion, and make me new! Give me the strength to follow You and walk in holiness. I surrender my heart fully to You. In Jesus’ name, AMEN!"
